purpose: Replicate the current-tree variable-token MambaACF candidate with paired shared-trunk controls, a causal AutoCon relation null, and a fixed short budget.
evidence_boundary: This is an unauthorized exploratory replication plan. It is limited to H96 on ETTh1 and traffic and cannot establish a general Mamba, ACF, or publication claim.
claim_boundary: The variable-token branch changes the forecast path only; in the current implementation the AutoCon representation is computed before that branch. A lambda contrast therefore cannot be described as relation learning over variable-token forecasts.

run parameter, GPU smoke, streaming-equivalence, and train-only ACF sidecar checks

seed_policy.reason: Fresh seeds relative to the completed 2021-2023 variable-token screen; no completed screen result is reused as a replication seed.

MambaACFVariable.provenance_rule: Keep the alias in the manifest and config hash; persist the resolved executable model and overrides in every job record.

MambaACFVariableAutoCon.provenance_rule: Keep the alias in the manifest and config hash; persist the resolved executable model and overrides in every job record.

phases.name: shared_memory_off_h96
phases.purpose: Current-tree shared temporal MambaACF trunk with all ACF forecast and relation branches disabled.

phases.name: shared_memory_on_h96
phases.purpose: Current-tree shared temporal trunk with static train-only raw ACF memory and no relation objective.

phases.name: variable_memory_off_h96
phases.purpose: Variable-token forecast branch with the same shared temporal trunk and train-only ACF fitting path, but forecast memory disabled.

phases.name: variable_memory_on_h96
phases.purpose: Variable-token forecast branch with static train-only raw ACF memory and no relation objective.

phases.name: variable_relation_null_h96
phases.purpose: Identical variable-token AutoCon architecture and sampler as the relation arm, with an explicit lambda=0 relation null.

phases.name: variable_relation_h96
phases.purpose: Identical variable-token AutoCon architecture and sampler as the null arm, with the frozen signed global relation weight lambda=0.03.

primary_contrast.interpretation: Combined candidate versus the current-tree shared ACF-memory control; this is a performance contrast and is not a pure variable-token or pure relation contrast.

mechanistic_contrasts.interpretation: Only registered causal relation contrast: same executable AutoCon architecture, sidecar, lags, split, optimizer, and budget; lambda differs only between 0.03 and 0.0.
ACF forecast-memory contrast within the variable-token branch.
Variable-token branch contrast at the same memory setting.
ACF memory contrast without the variable-token branch.

comparison_contract.confounding_boundary: The AutoCon-null arm retains the AutoCon representation and relation sampler but multiplies the relation objective by zero. The null-to-lambda=.03 contrast identifies the incremental objective under this architecture, not a claim that variable-token forecasts are represented by the relation head.
comparison_contract.sidecar_contract: For every dataset-seed coordinate, all six arms must use the same raw train-only ACF sidecar identity and resolved effective forecast lags. The two relation arms must additionally agree on relation candidate and effective lag sets.
comparison_contract.cross_plan_boundary: The existing variable-token fair screen (seeds 2021-2023, eight epochs) and the non-variable fair-baseline screen are historical exploratory context only. Do not pool their metrics with this fresh-seed matrix or use the source-mismatched non-variable screen as a current-tree comparator.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: Even a favorable result is a mechanism replication at H96 on two datasets. It is not evidence for superiority over PatchTST/Mamba2, longer horizons, or a publishable claim without a separately frozen full confirmation protocol.

analysis_gate.unit: five seed-level paired contrasts within each dataset; datasets are not independent replicates and are not pooled for the primary gate
report: exact paired permutation or Wilcoxon sensitivity
analysis_gate.multiplicity: Use Holm adjustment over the two datasets for the primary performance contrast and separately over the two datasets for the relation contrast. P-values are descriptive with n=5 and cannot be used to select a winner.

practical_promotion_threshold.candidate_vs_shared_memory_on: In both datasets, mean scaled-MSE ratio <= 0.995, at least 3/5 seed wins, and no dataset mean harm > 1.0%.
practical_promotion_threshold.relation_vs_null: In both datasets, mean scaled-MSE ratio <= 0.995, at least 3/5 seed wins, and no dataset mean harm > 1.0%.
practical_promotion_threshold.memory_vs_off: The variable memory arm must not have >1.0% mean harm in either dataset; a gain is descriptive unless the relation and candidate gates also pass.

analysis_gate.noninferiority_reference: For a later confirmatory protocol, retain a predeclared 1% multiplicative MSE margin (log threshold log(1.01)); this replication alone cannot establish noninferiority because n=5 and the budget is short.
analysis_gate.failure_action: If any arm has a missing/duplicate coordinate, non-finite metric, sidecar mismatch, or provenance drift, mark the affected cell invalid and do not replace it in this output root. If the practical gates fail, stop promotion and report the candidate as exploratory or drop the relation objective; do not add seeds, horizons, or lambdas after seeing results.

budget_contract.optimizer: Adam-compatible trainer in the current run.py
budget_contract.split: train_ratio=0.6 with the repository validation/test protocol
budget_contract.rationale: Exact replay budget of the completed variable-token screen; this deliberately remains an exploratory replication and is not the 50-epoch confirmation budget.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; validation and dry-run expansion are the only permitted actions for this draft.
Do not compare this fresh-seed matrix with the old fair-baseline numbers as if they were one paired experiment.
Do not use test metrics, epoch selection, or failed-job replacement to alter the frozen arm set, seed set, lag set, or thresholds.
Stop and preserve the output root if any source, data, sidecar, relation-lag, or artifact-hash invariant fails.
Do not promote to H336/H720 or external-baseline claims unless both the candidate and relation practical gates pass in both datasets and a new plan is reviewed.
A non-significant result is not equivalence; with five seeds, report uncertainty and retain the null interpretation when the interval is wide.
